title: Kombucha Cocktails
notes: Simple Syrup is simply 2 parts white sugar to 1 part water heated until all the sugar is dissolved and then left to cool. Make a batch and keep it on hand.

methodSections.heading: Gin and Hibiscus
steps: A garden party in you mouth, floral hibiscus and botanical gin what more could you want on a warm afternoon on a patio soaking up the sun. Simply build the kombucha onto the gin in your favourite glass with ice and garnish.
